# Synthetic multi-period accounting truth

Every name, source, document and amount in this directory is fictional.
Expected values below were specified independently of engine report functions.

June 30: assets 13,600; liabilities 1,400; retained equity 9,000; fiscal-YTD
income 12,000 and expense 8,800, giving profit 3,200.

July: collect 400 of the opening receivable; pay 200 of the opening payable;
recognize 100 prepaid expense and 100 deferred revenue; accrue and pay 600 of
provider payroll; record depreciation 40. Bank activity is -400. July income
is 100, expense 740 and loss 640. Fiscal-YTD profit becomes 2,560.

July 31: bank 9,600, receivable 600, prepaid 500, fixed assets 2,400,
accumulated depreciation -440, payable -300, deferred revenue -500 and payroll
liability -300. Assets 12,660 equal liabilities 1,100 plus equity 11,560.

The service schedules cover the full calendar year, with six installments
already recognized before July's cutover. The opening summary is not detailed
transaction history for arbitrary pre-cutover months.
